learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to identify and interpret the main claim, supporting evidence, and implicit assumptions in argumentative texts.
Students will be able to analyze the logical structure of arguments and evaluate the strength and reliability of the reasoning used.
Students will be able to recognize common logical fallacies and reasoning problems that weaken the effectiveness of arguments.
Students will be able to differentiate between personal opinion and evidence-based analytical evaluation in academic reading and writing.
Students will be able to write a structured argument analysis essay that objectively evaluates an author's argument.

syllabus_topics: Basic components of arguments: claims, supporting evidence, assumptions, and reasoning types.
B2–B2+ level academic reading texts selected in line with course objectives.
Argumentative text excerpts selected from journal and newspaper articles.
Logical weaknesses such as insufficient evidence, weak analogies, and overgeneralization.
Argument analysis essay evaluating the effectiveness of a writer's reasoning.
